The '''Sedri system''' contained [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]], and was located in the [[Periphery/Legends|Periphery]].

The [[Star system/Legends|system]] had at least three orbiting [[Planet/Legends|planets]], the third of which was [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]] itself. Due to the presence of the [[Golden Sun]] on Sedri, [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computers]] registered the system as one giant [[Star/Legends|star]]. Ships were not able to plot courses to the Sedri system, leading to the isolation of the [[Sedrian]]s for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]].<ref name="BGS" />
